  agent_failure_modes:

      description: If the Planner continues to issue verification requests despite sufficient evidence (as seen in steps 10-16), it creates an unnecessary loop without adding new value.
      severity: 0.6

- From_agent: WebSurfer

  agent_strength: 0.95
  agent_explanation: WebSurfer consistently references previous search results (e.g., confirming the same Wikipedia snippet) to reinforce the finding, allowing the Planner to recognize convergence and finalize the task.
  agent_failure_modes:
